## Checklist

- [ ] `make fmt lint test` passes
- [ ] `make test-integration` passes, or the change can't affect it
- [ ] `openapi.yaml` updated if an HTTP endpoint changed
- [ ] SDKs kept at parity (Go / TypeScript / Python), or a follow-up issue is open
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] New migration is append-only, with a matching `.down.sql`
